label: Double Pleat
description: A double pleat at the cuff places two small folds of fabric where the sleeve meets the cuff, distributing the gather across two tucks. This handles a fuller sleeve more smoothly and is regarded as a more traditional, refined shirtmaking detail. The paired pleats give the wrist a slightly more structured, sartorial finish than a single pleat.
